findings.title_ko: predictive error 제곱 underflow로 clamp 방향 역전
findings.consequence: Positive finite tiny controller inputs can request 25x the intended clamped next step; prevalence on normal trajectories unmeasured.
findings.claim_ceiling: Public controller defect; not a measured benchmark failure rate.

findings.title_ko: unscaled norm overflow가 fallback을 fail-open으로 만듦
findings.consequence: Inf<=Inf accepts an inaccurate finite candidate at the copied driver callback predicate; scale1e100 control rejects.
findings.claim_ceiling: Public staged solver callback with literal private-driver predicate; no direct private-driver/ODE trajectory reproduction.

findings.consequence: A floor/stall label is not evidence of requested-target accuracy; fallback-only G3 cannot cover all approximate accepted stages.
findings.claim_ceiling: Recorded statuses are intentional heuristics; no newly reproduced global endpoint failure.

findings.title_ko: 표본 tau와 projected nu는 full nonlinear error certificate가 아님
findings.consequence: A verified local gain needs full-space operator authority; whole-stage transfer additionally needs tube/roundoff/global transport.
findings.claim_ceiling: Exact algebraic counterexample to a generic inference, not a new ALG04 trajectory.

findings.title_ko: pilot defect Simpson 적분에 quadrature enclosure 부재
findings.consequence: Pilot dense-error agreement cannot be promoted to a machine total certificate without integration/rounding remainder.
findings.claim_ceiling: Affects pilot authority and future porting; not current default production certificate.

findings.title_ko: clipped request restoration와 trial no-growth cap 구분 필요
findings.consequence: Informative clip restores requested step and clears pending rejection; factor cap alone is not actual-trial no-growth.
findings.claim_ceiling: Consistent with registered restoration semantics; not classified as a proved implementation violation.

findings.title_ko: ALG06 h0 sensitivity 원자료의 지속 보존 누락
findings.consequence: Quantitative sensitivity warning has narrative provenance only; preserve warning without calling it independently replayed raw evidence.
findings.claim_ceiling: Historical review warning reused; no old sensitivity rerun.

severity_scope: P1 blocks promotion of the affected opt-in path or evidence authority; no blanket default regression claim.
